subject: Possible Thursday visit around noon
text: I wanted to confirm whether your team could host our field technician on Thursday, because I reviewed the maintenance notes and the access panel is now scheduled for inspection in the same hour as your morning queue. If Thursday is too crowded, a visit near closing time could be just as useful, since fewer interruptions make it easier to check the wiring without delaying service. Would that timing work for you? I can bring the latest photos from the support tickets and suggest a simple labeling step that may prevent the same misconnection from appearing again. Before then, if you have a preferred entrance or a supervisor who needs to sign the work order, please let me know so I can include those details in the dispatch notes. I also thought it might help to run the test on a quiet device first, which can reveal whether the fault is internal or simply caused by nearby equipment. Thanks for your time.
